entries.008a9e420bd65d34: This area imports and sells software made by overseas manufacturers and provides technical support and customization for it. It handles the “Blue SDK” Bluetooth protocol stack, the “InsydeH2O” BIOS, middleware, the “CodeSonar” static analysis tool, security verification tools and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,275 million.
entries.13a96a041d037e13: A company that handles its own embedded software products and the import and sale of overseas software, providing manufacturing customers with technologies such as networking and security, along with development support.
entries.1e225c3f5d41b22b: This business provides proprietary software products for embedded devices, including networking, security, fast boot and database software, and engages in design and development centered on the import and sale of overseas software with technical support and contract work on embedded software, and in licensing of data content. Its head office is located in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, and the consolidated subsidiary Grape System Co., Ltd. also carries out this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,992 million.

entries.67a9c937cd8cf835: A business in which consolidated subsidiary Lightstone Co., Ltd. imports and sells statistical and numerical data analysis software and provides technical support. It provides scientific and technical software such as “Origin” and “Stata” to educational institutions such as universities and technical colleges, government-affiliated research institutions, and research and development and survey departments of companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥931 million.
entries.74c96009f7088de4: This area provides embedded software products developed in-house. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥772 million.
